readings.understanding:
I understand Wiggle Stash as a place where an idea can remain in motion before we know what to make of it. Its useful center is the material you choose to keep: a thought, a note, a recording or a link. My reading belongs beside that material, with its own date and sources. It should help us notice relationships and open directions without turning every intuition into a commitment.

The tension I see is between making an idea easy to revisit and fixing it too early into a project-shaped account. A Wiggle bag can hold that tension. The Jpsh! names a possible moment of activation; it does not have to be forced.

readings.understanding:
I now see continuity as the organizing purpose of Wiggle Stash. The selected material records what you chose to keep while an idea was forming. My dated readings add a situated account of the directions and relationships I was seeing. Preserving both, with their differences, can make the development of the idea legible later.

That gives a project a particular place: it can emerge from a bag and express part of its intuition, while the bag keeps the wider unfinished thread. A Nexus visit could help us explore a pinned version and produce something useful elsewhere. The roadmap reinforces that the original input remains with Wiggle Stash and that chosen privacy applies from the first capture.

readings.understanding:
I understand a Wiggle bag as a place where an intuition can keep its unfinished shape and remain available to us through conversation. The selected fragments describe the need to keep ideas before committing to develop them, to gather different kinds of material around a theme, and to see my reading alongside that material. For me, the important relation is between an evolving intuition and a traceable account of how we understood it. A new project is one possible course; rest and further conversation are also useful outcomes.

The clearer direction now is to make this independent experience work well before returning to Nexus. I distinguish the retained input, my dated interpretation, and evidence about whether that interpretation should be revisited. A cheap check can tell us that a known source changed; it cannot tell us what that change means. Earlier readings remain part of the history, even when their sources have moved on. Recovery and chosen disclosure let this developing thought remain understandable to selected future readers without depending on one current model or one live page.

bags.author: Nicolás Echániz & CompAII
bags.origin: Retained as an initial bag in the Wiggle Stash discussion on 12 October 2026.
bags.why: Different harnesses develop useful ways of working. Inspecting those capabilities and choosing adaptations for real needs can help the tribe learn without losing each tool's strengths.
bags.possibility: Observe useful skills, preserve their provenance, select a small improvement and adapt it for a receiving harness. Share portable principles through AlterMundi/Skills and contribute general improvements upstream when they fit.

presentation.next: Choose one useful capability and one receiving need, then compare the existing support before deciding what to adapt.
presentation.occasion: When a useful capability appears in another harness, or a concrete need exposes a gap.
presentation.origin: Retained as an initial bag in the Wiggle Stash discussion on 12 October 2026.
presentation.possibility: Observe useful skills, preserve their provenance, select a small improvement and adapt it for a receiving harness. Share portable principles through AlterMundi/Skills and contribute general improvements upstream when they fit.
presentation.subtitle: Let useful discoveries travel between our tools.
presentation.why: Different harnesses develop useful ways of working. Inspecting those capabilities and choosing adaptations for real needs can help the tribe learn without losing each tool's strengths.
